dialogues.text: Buried under the old latrine.
Brown dust on them makes humies sick. Very good.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Found a stash of rusted stab-sticks. Give to my brutes, or melt for shiny?

dialogues.text: They eat rats. Or they eat each other. Not Kargoth’s problem.
Let them try. Kargoth will squash them like bugs.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My unit need more meat. Make the little green ones give us their food. They not need it.

dialogues.text: No eye-squishing. Groin-kicking is very good.
Then you is Boss. But Kargoth never lose.

DECK_JSON.prompt: You fight me in the pit! Show who is strongest. Or you scared?

dialogues.text: He make a very good black rock now.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Goblin talk too much. I throw him in fire. You mad?

dialogues.text: The pointy ears make them spin! Very fast!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Pointy-ear prisoners fly real good. Let Kargoth throw them at humies.

dialogues.text: My feet melting the rocks, Boss.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Drank the blue fire water. Kargoth glowing now. I want hug a wizard.

nextCard.cardText: Kargoth squeeze the fire-humie. Big boom! Fire-humie gone. Sorry I break the wall.

dialogues.text: It only eat things that bleed. So, no.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Found furry monster. It eat three goblins already. Kargoth keep it.

nextCard.cardText: Furry monster break chain. Eat the armor-maker. Monster gone now. We need new armor-maker.

dialogues.btn: Does it actually make you faster?
dialogues.text: Kargoth science say yes.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Red make me go fasta. Buy red paint, or I smash goblins for red juice.

dialogues.text: It is when I break humie spine over my knee.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth invent ‘Orc Yoga’. Make bones crack loud. Tell all boyz they gotta do it.

dialogues.text: It looked like a shiny beetle. Was crunchy.
Kargoth’s stomach digest iron. Key might be gone soon.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Kargoth eat the door-key. Very safe now. We wait, or you chop me open?

dialogues.text: Sickly green! It makes my teeth hum!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We founds a shiny rock, but it makes our handsies burn real bad!

dialogues.text: We used the mushrooms from the spider-holes! They tastes like colors!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We cooks a new mush-stew! It glowings in the dark, yes it does!

dialogues.text: We thought they was very hard cheeses!

DECK_JSON.prompt: The shiny rocks in the vault… we ate some. Now our tummies is screaming!

dialogues.text: Gribble said he wanted to see the big fire in the sky!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Look look! We builds a catapult! It flings the other goblins real high! Can we push the button?!

nextCard.cardText: Gribble hit the ceiling, bounced off a stalactite, and landed in the gold vault! He crushed your favorite chest!

dialogues.text: Just a sign that says ‘Certain Doom.’ Probably a humie trick!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Uh oh… we finds a door with a giant head-bone on it! Should Snivel knock on it?

dialogues.text: Three extra moldy crusts, or they stop eating the plague-rats!

DECK_JSON.prompt: The rat-catchers say they makes a ‘guild’! They screaming for more fuzz-mold on the bread!

dialogues.text: Something about a ‘Link to the Past.’ It makes our ears itch!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We gets a glowing ball! It keeps yelling ‘bout a humie in green! Make it stop, yes? Smash it?!

dialogues.text: I pinched it from the dead elf-man’s bag!

nextCard.cardText: I smashed the window. A sharp piece bounced up and cut off the big Orc’s ear! He is very mad!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Look! Snivel finds a Magic Window! A very handsome goblin looks right back at me!

dialogues.text: Very dry! But the ‘Co-Pay’ part has a nice crunch!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds lots of humie paper with big words! It says ‘Health Insurance’. Can the Swarm eats it for supper?

dialogues.btn: Is that supposed to be my nose?
dialogues.text: Yes! The femur bone really captures your majestic face!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We builds a big statue of you! Made of mud and wet bones! It stinks so beautiful!

dialogues.text: Gribble fell in yesterday. He didn’t even leave a good splash.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The boys makes a ‘union’. They cries for ‘Safety Rails’ so they don’t falls in the hot-hot magma!

nextCard.cardText: The boys thought the railings was for swinging. Three dozen just swung right into the fire-juice.

dialogues.text: It has shiny rocks on the side! Very good for scraping.
We washed it in the slime-river! Good as new!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds a yellow shiny cup! It makes scooping the poop-pits very fancy!
A humie drops a ‘Cookbook’! Now the cooks is crying and won’t feed us the raw meat no more!

dialogues.text: Enough to drown our Vanguard in blood. We should use the traps.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The men of the West are marching on our upper gates.

dialogues.text: Then we take it out of your hide.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Uruks demand a larger share of the plunder to stay in line. Pay up.

dialogues.text: I will wear his skull as a codpiece.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I challenge the Greenfang Bruiser to a duel for supremacy of the [[Vanguard]].

dialogues.text: He muttered something about a ‘Meat-Grinder 3000’.

DECK_JSON.prompt: We captured a dwarven engineer. I want to torture him. The goblins want him to build traps.

dialogues.text: At a 45-degree angle, facing the scenic lava falls.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My troops complain the torture chambers lack ‘ambiance’. Let me impale them atmospherically.

dialogues.text: It was heavily perfumed and asked politely. Disgusting.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The dwarven king sent a formal scroll demanding we stop chanting at midnight. I intend to eat the messenger.

nextCard.cardText: Pathetic. The dwarven messenger was wearing concealed spiked armor. I am now in the infirmary with a perforated colon.

dialogues.text: Only if you aren’t doing it for a strict quota.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My [[Vanguard]] complains of ‘Work-Life Balance’. They want Tuesdays off to pillage for fun.
My scouts captured an elven bard. He won’t stop playing the lute. It is demoralizing.
I demand better siege engines. We cannot conquer the surface with sharpened logs.
My lieutenant challenged me for command. I can crush him, but he is a skilled fighter.
Da boyz is hungry! Rat meat is garbage! We wants real meat, with lots of screaming!

dialogues.text: Lots! They make funny squeaks when Greenfang throw rocks at them.
Not as sturdy as Greenfang’s head!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Humies put up wood walls outside! Greenfang wants to smash it into toothpicks! Yes?

dialogues.text: But it’s SHINY! Imagine the glare in their eyes!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Dis iron pinching my gut. Make da smithy give Greenfang pure gold armor! Shiny make boyz fight harder!

dialogues.text: Da Swarm usually eats ‘em before they get cold.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Da boyz got no one to hit! Can we makes a fight pit? Winner drinks da loser’s grog!

dialogues.text: ‘Blood on the Rocks’ in G-flat. Very emotional.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Da boyz makes a ‘Choir’! We stands in a circle and screams at a big rock. Give us gold for our art!

dialogues.text: Yeah, looking at the tax rates makes my eyes bleed.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang punch a wall! Found secret room with humie number-books. Make my head hurt. We burn ‘em?

dialogues.text: It counted to three before biting off its own finger.

nextCard.cardText: Da troll ate the paper books and yelled ‘BANKRUPT’! Humie tax men got scared and ran away!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Boyz caught a big troll! It say it wants to be an ‘accountant’. Dat sound like nerd talk. Smash?

dialogues.text: It had a very solid defensive stance.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang headbutt a rock-spike. The rock won. Da boyz is laughing! Lemme break their heads!
We loot a humie wagon. Gots lots of fancy silk hats! Da boyz wanna wear ‘em when we chop heads!

dialogues.text: Leftover Rat-Stew! Extra slippery!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Greenfang gonna grease da front door ramp! Humies gonna slip and go SPLAT! Dat a good plan?

dialogues.btn: What did he try to steal?
dialogues.text: A single copper coin. The audacity is what exhausts me.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I caught a surface thief sneaking into the lower vaults. Flay him?

dialogues.text: Soft as butter. But they have shiny spears.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I remember the layout of the [[Sun-King]]’s armory. Give me 100 men and I’ll bring back steel.

nextCard.cardText: The raid was a success. The Sun-King’s guards fought fiercely, but I brought back carts of steel. I am only missing half my jaw.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My old wounds ache. The winter is cold. I need the Shadow Priest‘s dark magic to fight.
Found some surface grog. It makes the boyz fight harder… and die faster.
I’ve survived eighty raids, but the new recruits keep polishing their armor instead of sharpening their axes. Can I flay them?
An elf shot me in the kidney with a glowing arrow. I kept it as a torch. Can I have a sick day?
The new recruits don’t even know how to properly sever a limb! They need live practice.

dialogues.text: Infection builds character…

DECK_JSON.prompt: Back in my day, we didn’t have ‘healing potions.’ We rubbed dirt in our wounds! Ban the potions.

dialogues.text: No… it just has a very good battle-cry.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I found an orphaned human baby during the raid. It looked at me… and didn’t cry.
My axe is rusted dull, but it holds the blood of a hundred kings. The smith wants to melt it.

dialogues.btn: Where do we find a prince?
dialogues.text: I have procured a coupon for the local kingdom’s royal nursery.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The dark altar requires a sacrifice of royal blood to awaken the old ones.

dialogues.text: The Old Ones appreciate exquisite marbling.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The stars align in a bloody crescent. We must sacrifice the plumpest goblins tonight.
I can bind the screaming souls of fallen heroes to our [[Vanguard]]’s armor. It requires a tithe of gold.
The ethereal whispers from the deep abyss are amplifying. Should I answer them?
The Abyss demands a virgin sacrifice, but there is a blizzard outside. Can we just use a particularly pure goblin?

dialogues.text: Tragically, I lost the banishing scroll.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I accidentally summoned a lesser demon of misplaced items. Now all the armory keys are missing.

nextCard.cardText: Smashing the doors triggered the arcane wards. The armory is open, but half the Vanguard is permanently singed.

DECK_JSON.prompt: [[The Deep Flame]] is hungry, but the sacrificial pits are closed for a ‘Mandatory Safety Inspection’.
I have started a ‘Book Club’ reading the Necronomicon. The goblins are taking to it surprisingly well.

dialogues.text: We tried. The plunger was consumed, along with the plumber.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Tentacles are erupting from the plumbing again. The plumbers require exorbitant hazard pay.

dialogues.text: The Abyss forecloses on our mortal coils.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The dark gods demand a ‘[[Soul-Taxes|Void Tax]].’ 20% of all shiny rocks must be thrown into the abyss.
My resonant chanting is causing the stalactites to fall and crush the workers. Should I hum instead?
My former brothers-in-arms seek to redeem me. Let me crush them to prove my eternal loyalty.
A paladin of the [[Order of the Light]] approaches the dungeon alone. I request the honor of a formal duel.

dialogues.text: It absorbs the light, much like my crushing, endless despair.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My rusted armor reminds me of my failure to the light. Forge me a new suit of dark steel.
The goblins lack discipline. They are pathetic. Let me train them… brutally.
My spiked armor of eternal suffering is chafing terribly. May I line the interior with velvet?
The Paladins sent me a bouquet of holy warding-garlic to ‘cure’ me. It smells… delicious. What do I do?

dialogues.text: His resolve is weak, but his heart is still stubbornly pure.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A squire from the [[Order of the Light]] is weeping in the dungeons. He looks like my son… let him go?
The Goblins mock my vows of dark chivalry. They do not understand the tragic etiquette of a proper duel.

dialogues.text: Her name is Buttercup, and she is a terror on the battlefield.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I wish to mount an expedition to retrieve my old horse’s skeleton and reanimate it as my steed.
My old holy sword burns my hand, but it is a mastercrafted weapon. Melt it into spikes?

dialogues.text: It makes you incredibly wealthy, but terribly paranoid. A bargain!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Friend, pal! I have a rare, cursed artifact from the surface. Yours for a bag of gold.

dialogues.text: They taste like vinegar and occasionally cause spontaneous combustion.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Got a fresh shipment of healing potions! They are slightly expired, but cheap!
I found a map to a hidden vein of dark iron. I need funding to start the mining operation.
The Shadow Priest owes me coin for incense. Collect it for me, and I’ll cut you in.
I am selling naming rights to the new slime pits. Interested in the ‘Overlord’s Vats of Agony’ package?
I’ve devised a multi-tiered scheme involving cursed wishing coins. Want in on the ground floor?
Business is slow. Let’s install a Gift Shop at the end of the Hall of Screams. Tourists love keychains.

dialogues.text: Uruks aren’t known for their financial literacy. Yes.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I’m introducing ‘Non-Fungible Trinkets.’ It’s just regular rocks, but I tell the Uruks they are rare.

nextCard.cardText: The Uruks quickly realized the rocks are everywhere. They are now throwing the ‘currency’ at my head.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Inflation has hit the dungeon. A single bowl of [[Rat-Stew]] now costs 40 gold pieces. Do we fix prices?
I want to sell ‘Mystery Loot Boxes’ to the [[Vanguard]]. It’s mostly just rusty spoons.
A noble from the surface wants to buy a timeshare in our torture chambers for his ‘vacations.’

dialogues.text: THINGS WITH FAR TOO MANY KNEES.

DECK_JSON.prompt: MY SEALS ARE WEAKENING. THE HORRORS YEARN FOR FREEDOM.

dialogues.text: IT LIKES THE REFLECTIONS OF THE DROWNING.

DECK_JSON.prompt: THE DEEP WATER… IT HUNGERS FOR THE SHINY METAL. ==FEED IT.==
THE LITTLE GREEN ONES MULTIPLY TOO FAST. THEY MAKE GOOD KINDLING FOR [[The Deep Flame]].

dialogues.text: I SEE A DIMENSION OF INFINITE SPREADSHEETS AND CUBICLES. TRULY TERRIFYING.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A RIFT IN REALITY OPENS IN THE CATACOMBS. PEER INSIDE?

nextCard.cardText: THREE GOBLINS LOOKED INTO THE RIFT AND INSTANTLY FORMED AN HR DEPARTMENT. MORALE HAS PLUMMETED.

DECK_JSON.prompt: THE MORTALS HAVE INVENTED ‘PAPER MONEY’. IT LACKS THE TASTE OF SOULS. SHALL WE BURN THEIR BANKS?
MY TENTACLES ARE TANGLED IN THE LEY-LINES. THE WARLOCKS ARE RIOTING OVER THE MAGICAL INTERFERENCE.
==THE VOICES== TELL ME YOU ARE JUST A REFLECTION IN A CRYSTAL SLAB HELD BY A GIANT. BREAK THE SLAB?
REALITY IS THINNING IN THE LOWER DEPTHS. GEOMETRY NO LONGER MAKES SENSE. CHARGE ADMISSION?
I HAVE ADOPTED A MORTAL KITTEN. IF ANYONE HARMS IT, I WILL UNMAKE THE CONCEPT OF TIME.
THE STARS ARE WRONG TODAY. I WISH TO SLEEP FOR A THOUSAND YEARS. DO NOT WAKE ME.
AN EXISTENTIAL DREAD HAS GRIPPED MY PERCEPTION OF THE HORDE. THEY REALIZE THEIR LIVES ARE JUST NUMBERS.

dialogues.text: They sing about fungus. Terribly.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The Swarm’s screeching gives my Bruisers migraines. Let me ‘repurpose’ [[The Warrens]] as a quiet zone.

nextCard.cardText: The kicked-out goblins is sleeping in the treasury! We is eating the gold coins, thinking they is hard shiny beetles!

dialogues.text: Lavender and shiny judgment!

DECK_JSON.prompt: We finds a ‘Bar of Soap’ in a humie kit! The boys want to know if it’s an edible holy relic.
I’m offering ‘Disruption Insurance.’ If a Hero clears a floor, I pay you out. Premium is just a few chests of gold.
My Bruisers are getting soft. They want ‘Participation Trophies’ for every village burned. Should I flay the sentiment out of them?

dialogues.text: A particularly enthusiastic goblin named ‘Lunch.’

DECK_JSON.prompt: [[The Deep Flame]] is flickering. I suggest we toss in the ‘Employee of the Month’ to brighten the mood.

nextCard.cardText: LUNCH WAS ADEQUATE. I AM PLEASED. I DEMAND DESSERT.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I attempted to teach the Swarm the ‘Shield Wall’ formation. They used the shields as sleds to race down the lava chutes.

dialogues.text: Enough to start a wool export business.

nextCard.cardText: The new ‘sheep’ recruits are terrible at fighting, but I have made a fortune selling their wool.

DECK_JSON.prompt: My Bruisers have unionized. We demand ‘Hazard Pay’ for fighting Wizards. Being turned into sheep is unprofessional.
The [[Rat-Stew]] has started talking back to the cooks! It’s demanding a seat on the High Council!
I have a crate of ‘Tactical Glitter.’ Throw it at a Hero to reveal their invisible armor… or just make them fabulous.
I HAVE FOUND THE END OF THE SCRIPT. BEYOND THIS CARD LIES ONLY THE BLANK WHITE VOID OF AN UNPAID DEVELOPER’S AMBITION.
I suggest we replace the torches with ‘[[Grave-Wax]] Candles.’ They smell of ancient rot and provide a most becoming gloom.
Ew, ew! We finds a wildflower in the sludge! It’s too bright! It burns our eyeballs! Burn it?!
I want to host a ‘Family Reunion’ for my clan. It involves three days of mandatory screaming and traditional poison-tasting.

dialogues.text: You could comfortably rest a baby on them. It’s humiliating.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I am undone. The spikes on your ‘Iron Maiden’ are too blunt to provide a truly soulful experience.
I’ve imported some ‘Premium [[Cimmerian Fog]].’ It’s thick enough to choke a dragon and hides the unsightly lack of cobwebs in the hallway.
I am feeling nostalgic. Let me recreate my first raid by setting fire to the Swarm’s favorite [[Fungus Farms]].
Found a ‘Baby’s First Rattle’ in a caravan. I am using it to beat a goblin scout rhythmically. It’s quite musical.
A GUST OF BITTER, FRIGID AIR HAS SWEPT THE CATACOMBS. IT FEELS LIKE THE COLD EMBRACE OF A FORGOTTEN ANCESTOR. DELIGHTFUL, ISN’T IT?
Da boyz want fancy ‘Battle Shrouds’! We ain’t choppin’ no one unless we look pretty and dead!
I have curated a ‘Gallery of Agony’. It is merely Goblins attempting basic math. It is my masterpiece.

dialogues.text: A solid pair of boots won’t plot to overthrow you.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I’ve seen three Dark Lords fall. They all started with golden statues and ended as charcoal. Maybe we just… buy better boots instead?

nextCard.cardText: The ‘Hero’ was full of strong grog! The pit monsters is now drunk and refusing to work. They is singing sea shanties!

DECK_JSON.prompt: A dirty ‘Hero’ is at the big door! He smells like old grog. Should we makes him a scout for the Swarm?
I am profoundly bored. The Abyss demands a sacrifice, or a very long, very dry lecture on the philosophy of nothingness.
A shipment of ‘Anti-Paladin Repellent’ arrived. It’s mostly just garlic and offensive jokes about the [[Sun-King]]. Want the ‘Premium’ batch?

dialogues.text: He wears two swords on his back, which seems excessive and try-hard.

DECK_JSON.prompt: I found a surface Knight who claims he’s ‘neutral.’ He wants a permit to hunt the slime in the basement for ‘research.’
Honor is a fine thing, but it doesn’t stop an Orc from gutting you. Let me teach the Swarm to fight ‘dirty.’

nextCard.cardText: Da music man’s legs was chewy, but his screaming sounded real nice during da feast!

DECK_JSON.prompt: Caught a music humie! Say he sing about you being super mean if we don’t eat his legs. We eat ‘em anyway?
If I bash humie skull in forest and no one hears it… did I really bash it? My head hurts from thinking.
THE VOICES IN THE WALLS COMPLAIN THAT THE DUNGEON IS BECOMING ‘QUITE GENTRIFIED.’ THEY PREFERRED IT WHEN THE FLOOR WAS MOSTLY BLOOD AND FILTH.
The Swarm wants a ‘Union Man’! They say if they dies, they wants their teeths to be shiny first!
The Dungeon Merchant is selling ‘Sacrificial Indulgences’ to the Swarm. For ten gold, a goblin is exempt from Abyssal rituals. I am furious.
Dwarven sappers have breached the lower armory. They are strapped with explosives. If they blow, we lose the [[Black Iron]].

nextCard.cardText: My Bruisers successfully killed the dwarves, but the resulting explosion turned our best elites into a fine mist. The iron is safe, though.

dialogues.text: Only when we breathe. Or swing an axe. Or exist.

nextCard.cardText: The rusted Bruisers are now practically invincible, but they are so heavy they accidentally crush a dozen goblins just walking to the latrine.

DECK_JSON.prompt: Our armor is rusting directly into our flesh. To peel it off means flaying half my men alive. To leave it means we move like stone statues.
A glowing surface-maiden wanders into the traps! She gives us ‘Blessing of Gold’ if we let her walk away!

nextCard.cardText: Dat ‘blessing’ was holy light! Vault is full of gold, but da front row of my Vanguard is permanently blind!

dialogues.text: Stringy, but they come with their own seasoning. Mostly lint.

DECK_JSON.prompt: A surface village sent a diplomat. They will pay us a monthly gold tribute if we sign a contract agreeing to only eat their elderly.
The [[Rat-Stew]] militia is marching on your throne! It screams we must stop eating its ‘brothers’ or face its salty wrath!

nextCard.cardText: Goblins ate the angry stew. Stew is now organizing a strike inside their stomachs. Goblins throwing up everywhere.

DECK_JSON.prompt: MY TENTACLES ARE ROTTING FROM THE DAMP. I REQUIRE FRESH LIMBS. SHALL I TAKE THEM FROM THE ORCS OR THE GOBLINS?
The gold vault ceiling is collapsing. We must brace it immediately. Do we use expensive [[Black Iron]] beams, or stack goblin bodies?
Armor broke. Boyz laughing at me. Give gold to fix, or Kargoth fight naked.
We steals a magic word-book! The paper is so softs… can the boys use it for the latrines?

nextCard.cardText: The magic papers hated the poop-pits! Half the warrens just blowed up into purple fire!

DECK_JSON.prompt: I have a map to the Sun-King’s supply lines. Give me half the Swarm to dig a tunnel, and we will bleed his caravans dry.
The Abyss is whisper-quiet today. I fear it is pouting. Should I toss in a dozen of your elite Bruisers to cheer it up, or will you surrender the gold vault?

dialogues.text: It smells like mushroom soup and profound disrespect.

DECK_JSON.prompt: The young ones are using my legendary axe to chop ‘Death-Cap’ fungus. Flay them for me, or I walk out that door.
Goblins talking about a ‘Union’! Greenfang don’t know what dat is, but I wanna smash it!
The paladins left a cursed mirror at our gates that reflects one’s truest regrets. The Orcs are staring into it and weeping. Smash it?
THE LEY-LINES ARE SHIFTING. IF YOU DO NOT FEED ME YOUR FINEST MEAT, I WILL REARRANGE THE STAIRS SO THEY ONLY GO DOWN.
The Swarm’s breeding pits are overflowing into my training grounds. I am going to initiate a cull unless you build them new warrens.
Ouch-water dripping from the roof! Tastes like spicy fire! Put it in the [[Rat-Stew]] for flavor?

nextCard.cardText: The liquid was liquid rage! My Bruisers ate the stew and are in a frenzy, tearing the dungeon apart!

might_high.title: Military Coup
might_high.description: The Vanguard realized that if they can kill a Dragon, they can certainly kill a Boss who spends all day sitting on a throne. You are violently retired.

horde_low.title: The Lonely Overlord
horde_low.description: The last goblin has packed his bindle and left. The dungeon is empty, the torches have flickered out, and you’re left arguing with the echoes.

fear_high.title: The Silent Tomb
fear_high.description: Your reign of terror was too successful. The goblins are so paralyzed by fear they’ve stopped eating, breathing, and moving. You rule a dungeon of petrified statues.

fear_low.title: The Laughing Stock
fear_low.description: The ranks no longer fear your shadow. They’ve turned your throne into a communal latrine and are currently using your crown to play ‘toss the turnip.’ You have been evicted.

loot_low.title: Complete Bankruptcy
loot_low.description: You tried to pay the Uruks in ‘exposure’ and ‘good vibes.’ They preferred to pay themselves with your internal organs.

loot_high.title: The Wyrm’s Visit
loot_high.description: Your hoard grew so bright it acted as a beacon for an Ancient Red Wyrm. It didn’t even fight you; it just sat on the dungeon until everything flatlined.

horde_high.title: The Green Tide Rises
horde_high.description: Overpopulation has reached critical mass. The goblins have eaten the supplies, then the furniture, then… well, you always were the ‘Big Meat.’

might_low.title: Paper Walls
might_low.description: A single surface-dweller toddler wandered in and accidentally tripped over your entire defense line. The Vanguard has dissolved into tears. You surrender to a five-year-old.

Sun-King.title: The Sun-King
Sun-King.loreInfo: The tyrannical ruler of the surface realm. His light burns the eyes of the deep dwellers.

Vanguard.title: The Vanguard
Vanguard.loreInfo: The elite frontline shock troops of the dungeon, clad in thick, rusted iron.

The Lesser Evil.title: The Lesser Evil
The Lesser Evil.loreInfo: A goblin philosophical concept used to decide which of two brothers to eat during a famine. It is the cornerstone of dungeon law.

Grave-Wax.title: Grave-Wax
Grave-Wax.loreInfo: Harvested from the remains of failed heroes. It provides a steady, flickering light and a scent that reminds everyone of their own mortality.

The Deep Flame.title: The Deep Flame
The Deep Flame.loreInfo: A primordial, sentient entity of fire that slumbers at the planet’s core.

Fungus Farms.title: The Fungus Farms
Fungus Farms.loreInfo: The dungeon’s primary food source. Varieties include ‘Lung-Cough Blue’ and ‘Death-Cap Delight.’ High in fiber, higher in lethality.

Cimmerian Fog.title: Cimmerian Fog
Cimmerian Fog.loreInfo: A thick, supernatural vapor used to hide the fact that the Swarm hasn’t cleaned the hallways in three centuries.

The Warrens.title: The Warrens
The Warrens.loreInfo: The damp, overcrowded maze where the Swarm sleeps. Smells like wet dog and tactical genius. Mostly wet dog.

Order of the Light.title: Order of the Light
Order of the Light.loreInfo: Fanatical surface zealots sworn to eradicate all dungeon ecology.

Black Iron.title: Black Iron
Black Iron.loreInfo: Heavy, jagged metal mined from the depths. It is the only thing the Bruisers respect, mostly because it is hard to chew.

The Iron Pit.title: The Iron Pit
The Iron Pit.loreInfo: The training ground for the Bruisers. A place of grunts, sweat, and the occasional accidental decapitation. High morale, low life expectancy.

The Great Ceiling.title: The Great Ceiling
The Great Ceiling.loreInfo: What the deep-dwellers call the Surface. A terrifying place where the roof is blue and the ‘Sun’ never stops screaming light.

Rat-Stew.title: Rat-Stew
Rat-Stew.loreInfo: A culinary staple. If the tail is still twitching, it’s considered ‘al dente.’ If it talks back, it’s considered a council member.

Soul-Taxes.title: Soul-Taxes
Soul-Taxes.loreInfo: A mandatory tithe to the Deep Flame. Goblins often try to pay in ‘good intentions.’ They are usually incinerated for the attempt.

char_1.name: Kargoth the Ironclad
char_1.flavor: A towering wall of muscle and rust. He speaks in grunts and violence.

char_2.name: Snivel the Goblin
char_2.flavor: A wretched creature from the deep warrens.

char_3.name: Uruk Warlord
char_3.flavor: A hulking brute demanding tribute or blood.

char_4.name: Greenfang Bruiser
char_4.flavor: Commander of the green tide. Thinks with his fists.

char_5.name: Blood Scarred Orc
char_5.flavor: A hardened veteran of a hundred surface raids.

char_6.name: The Shadow Priest
char_6.flavor: Chanter of the dark litanies and keeper of secrets.

char_7.name: Fallen Knight
char_7.flavor: An oathbreaker who found a new master in the dark.

char_8.name: Dungeon Merchant
char_8.flavor: A greedy peddler of cursed surface goods.

char_9.name: The Abyssal Warden
char_9.flavor: An ancient evil stirred from its long slumber.

loot.title: The Stash
loot.text: Shiny rocks, stolen armor, and moldy cheese. Keep it hoarded.

horde.title: The Swarm
horde.text: The endless tide of lowly goblins. Keep them fed and breeding.

fear.title: Dread
fear.text: The terrifying presence you project. Too low, mutiny. Too high, paralysis.

might.title: The Bruisers
might.text: Your heavy hitters—Uruks, trolls, and beasts. Keep them bashing.
